title: Why AI agents need a call ID before they spend money
description: Why Hubu takes a trusted per-call ID from the agent harness, never the tool's arguments, and turns it into the idempotency key that prevents double spend.

cover.alt: Hubu article cover with the title Why AI agents need a call ID before they spend money. A panel maps call IDs to operations: call_7f3a maps to op A, charged once; the same call_7f3a on retry maps to op A again, replayed with no new charge; a new call_9c1e maps to op B with a new charge.

title: Budgets that keep up with agents
description: A preview of the accounting precision work underway for Hubu v0.2.4, and why sub-cent agent spending makes it important now.

cover.alt: Hubu article cover: a budget moves from coarse cent divisions to precise micro-dollar divisions, with the title Budgets that keep up with agents.
